genimage_tiny_attribution.description: Tiny GenImage source attribution (Real + 7 generators) on the published split: fit on the 28,000 training images, predict the 7,000 held-out validation images (paper Table 1). Scored against hidden labels by eval/test/.

accuracy.description: Overall source-attribution accuracy (%) on the 7,000 held-out images (half are real).

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean per-class recall, which catches shortcuts that improve common classes while sacrificing harder generators.

precision_weighted.description: Weighted precision for source attribution, retaining continuity with the original aggregate classification report.

f1_weighted.description: Weighted F1 for source attribution, combining precision and recall at the aggregate class distribution.

f1_macro.description: Unweighted macro F1, which rewards methods that improve all generator classes rather than only the easiest ones.

worst_class_recall.description: Lowest per-source recall (%), exposing methods that abandon a difficult generator.

genimage_tiny_attribution.setup_note: Paper numbers are for the same public benchmark and split (Table 1: GenImage, 8 classes, 28k/7k). The hidden test is the full 7,000-image published validation split; the visible dev slice is a fixed 20% of the training split. No scaling of data or model.

genimage_tiny_binary.description: Tiny GenImage real-vs-fake detection on the same images, derived by the evaluator from the source prediction (real vs any generator) - the paper's 'without retraining for the specific task' setting (Table 2).

accuracy.description: Real-vs-fake accuracy (%) on the 7,000 held-out images (balanced, so it equals balanced accuracy).

precision_weighted.description: Weighted precision for the binary real-vs-fake task.

f1_weighted.description: Weighted F1 (%) for real-vs-fake; with balanced classes it equals macro F1.

worst_class_recall.description: Lower of real-image recall and fake-image recall (%).

genimage_tiny_binary.setup_note: Binary labels are not a separate submission: prediction 0 = real, any generator label = fake. Test is balanced 3,500/3,500.

_note: Rank = sum over experiments of weight x sum over metrics of coefficient x (score - reference score). All scored metrics are percentages in [0,100] recomputed from predictions; a failed submission scores 0 on every metric. Representation size is a policy constraint (scoring/CONSTRAINTS.md), not a scored metric, because it cannot be verified from predictions.
